scope: independent CPU replay of saved new_crop action rewards and fixed-reference optimizer records; no GT/postseal/media access

mechanics.reward: original aligned IoU of sigmoid(logit-space action) against the selected anchor box
mechanics.samples: 32 fixed antithetic Gaussian actions per anchor and optimizer round
mechanics.policy: q = softmax(IoU / tau); q and actions are detached in the score-function term
mechanics.control_variate: per-anchor KL(mean || rollout_mean) minus sum((q - 1/32) * logp); exact all-equal q is uniform and optimizer_step returns without Adam update
mechanics.reliability: loss is mean(reliability_i * per_anchor_loss_i), so weights are external, unnormalized by sum(reliability); global informative flag is exact reward inequality across all anchors
mechanics.validation: an additional label-free gate accepts only if weighted mean anchor IoU does not fall by more than 1e-7; rejected proposal restores state and Adam state and stops
mechanics.scope: 1792 spatial parameters; independent reader checks saved gradients/update vectors and state deltas but does not independently run decoder backward

interpretation.potential_next_mechanism: A pre-registered eligible-support or per-anchor informative gate may be tested as a new method; this audit does not claim one is effective and does not treat reward variance as an identity signal.

source_bindings.provenance_limit: The selected saved fits and math are independently re-read; the historical RUNTIME006 pin set omits some transitive Python imports listed above, so this readback does not claim byte-complete historical runtime provenance.
